verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the pack is a support-doc title for importing users from a CSV. That is a product-owned bulk operation, but it is limited to one object type and evidenced only by a heading. Alert grouping, deduplication and incident workflows are automation of individual incidents, not user-initiated bulk actions across many items, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: bulk actions on incidents (acknowledge/resolve/reassign many at once), bulk operations via REST API or MCP for AI agents, documented depth or limits of the CSV import, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
